label: James

text.NESTLE1904 1CO 15:6: ἔπειτα ὤφθη ἐπάνω πεντακοσίοις ἀδελφοῖς ἐφάπαξ, ἐξ ὧν οἱ πλείονες μένουσιν ἕως ἄρτι, τινὲς δὲ ἐκοιμήθησαν·
text.KJV 1CO 15:6: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
text.NESTLE1904 1CO 15:7: ἔπειτα ὤφθη Ἰακώβῳ, εἶτα τοῖς ἀποστόλοις πᾶσιν·
text.KJV 1CO 15:7: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
text.NESTLE1904 1CO 15:8: ἔσχατον δὲ πάντων ὡσπερεὶ τῷ ἐκτρώματι ὤφθη κἀμοί.
text.KJV 1CO 15:8: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

A.name: James
A.notes: fisherman (mending their nets- MAT 4:21), one of the Twelve (MAT 10:2)
family: son-of zebedee (Zebedee, father of James and John (MAT 4:21))

B.name: James
B.notes: "brother" in the sense that they were born of the same womb
family: servant-of yhvh (YHVH, the God of Israel)
brother-of judas-2 (Judas, brother of Jesus (MAT 13:55, MRK 6:3))

why: Ἰακώβῳ names one James separately before “all the apostles,” which weakly favors B over A, a member of the Twelve. However, neither this verse nor its neighbors gives a father, family relationship, or other detail that uniquely identifies him.
